basics.name: Eduardo López
basics.label: Full stack engineer
basics.summary: Full stack engineer and product builder with experience since 2015. Built web products for Nixtla and web or mobile applications for Selia and MarketPryce. Cofounded Amiloz, a Y Combinator W22 company, where I built the first products and led a technology team averaging seven people. I work across interfaces, APIs, product design, and software for business operations.

work.name: Nixtla
work.summary: Web products and developer experience for time series forecasting.
highlights: Built the website and developer portal, and contributed to early versions of the forecasting API.

work.name: Amiloz
work.summary: Built the first products for a company supplying corner stores in Mexico. Y Combinator W22.
highlights: Built the initial API, website, mobile apps, and internal tools, then hired and led a technology team averaging seven people.
Owned technology for customer ordering, warehouse operations, deliveries, and internal analytics.
The company raised more than USD 3.5 million and served hundreds of business customers.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Web and mobile products for founders and growing teams.
highlights: Built Selia's therapist marketplace across web, iOS, and Android, with tools for patients, therapists, and internal teams.
Developed MarketPryce's mobile apps, redesigned Ciro, and led development of CervezaSiempre for AB InBev.

Building Constructor, a companion product for creating applications from a description.
